Don't go to this restaurant EVER
Dec 2023 • Family
DISGUSTING EXPERIENCE NEVER EVER GO TO THIS RESTAURANT 

I would want to give zero rating to this restaurant 

We had gone for dinner on 8.12.23.

The property looked good.

We were asked to go on the 3rd floor. 

We placed our order & THEN WE WAITED & WAITED & WAITED BUT THE FOOD NEVER CAME.

After waiting for over 1.5 hours we left the restaurant without eating anything.

We ordered food at 8.55 pm & left at 10.20 pm with no food served!!!

The owner / manager who bragged about his restaurants did not have the courtesy to come & apologize for the delay even once !!!

When v left he was nowhere to be seen !!!

Along with us 6- 8 other guests also left without eating.

ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING EXPERIENCE, ABSOLUTELY ARROGANT MANAGEMENT.

APPEARS THAT THEY HAVE GROWN TOO BIG TO CARE FOR THE CUSTOMERS.

GO TO THIS RESTAURANT AT YOUR OWN PERIL !

Bestest Indian Food here
Jul 2023 • Couples
We are Indians settled in New Zealand. We are hoteliers ourselves and connoisseur of Indian food. We travel a lot to India and many other countries. It is for the first time that we had such a great food at this restaurant that I wanted to offer a job to the chef but that would have been not in the best interest of this restaurant. We had had dinner at other indian restaurants in the District 1 but those were nit even a scratch in gourmet quality here though they had good ambiance. This chef is hidden treasure. Equally impressive was the guy who served us. I vaguely remember his name as Ajay. You have got to go there to experience yourself. One suggestion to the Manager would be not to allow parking motorcycles at the entrance of the restaurant which blocks the view. Wishing you guy lots of accolades.
